name: default pose
description: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.
